problem_statement: Our text wrapper breaks a paragraph into lines no longer than `width` characters, keeping words whole and breaking only between them. Today it lets a line reach one character past the limit before breaking, so wrapping a line that exactly fills the width splits it early and can emit lines of `width + 1`. A line is allowed to be exactly `width` characters, never more. A word longer than `width` still takes a line of its own rather than being split, blank or whitespace-only input yields no lines, and lines never carry leading or trailing spaces or double spaces at the joins. A non-positive width raises ValueError.
